Jordan: Quick sync — I'm proposing a sequencing plan: land capacity-focused Dedicated improvements in wave 1, then a Private MVP in wave 2. Reason: predictable unit cost drops + unlocks dedicated contracts. Thoughts?

Maya: Can you add a quick RICE sketch? Also, PayGuard and MedLedger have flagged VPC + KMS + audit logs as blockers for them.

Samir: From runtime side: Dedicated work (batching, autoscale tuning, KV cache persistence) looks high-impact, relatively low engineering effort — should give ~3x throughput for common LLMs. Private MVP requires packaging and networking edge work; higher effort.

Alex: Capacity-first also helps our margins and makes Dedicated a more attractive sales pitch. Routing large customers to Dedicated while we parallelize Private reduces chaos.

Lia: Sales input: 2 large deals are private-required (regulated), but both are long-cycle. Dedicated commitments could close faster and fund Private work later.

Maya: Quick RICE roughs: Dedicated: Reach=7, Impact=6, Confidence=6, Effort=3 => RICE ~84. Private MVP: Reach=4, Impact=8, Confidence=5, Effort=6 => RICE ~26. (These are ballpark — want detailed scoring in PRD.)

Samir: Launch criteria suggestion:
- Dedicated wave: autoscale + predictable latency across p95/p99, 99.9% uptime SLA, per-route cost telemetry, verified on top-3 model families.
- Private MVP wave: private control plane (VPC peering), customer-managed KMS, audit logs, minimum config docs. Exclude on-prem installer in MVP.

Jordan: Scope negotiation: agree to scope Private MVP as VPC-managed offering (no on-prem binary). That reduces scope and shortens schedule.

Maya: Action items — I'll draft PRD with two-wave plan, attach RICE table, and explicit launch criteria. @Alex can you produce infra effort estimate by EOW?

Alex: Yep, will post an estimate and a high-level task breakdown by Friday.

deploybot: Created new doc /docs/roadmap/sequencing-proposal.md :white_check_mark:

Jordan: Great — I'll sync this into the roadmap status board after we get Alex's numbers. :rocket:
